evals.prompt: Take a screenshot of my current screen region, upload it to my free-tier GCS bucket, and copy the link to clipboard.
evals.expected_output: Executes snip.py which invokes screencapture, uploads to GCS, and copies the authenticated URL to the clipboard.
expectations: Uses snip.py to capture and upload the image
Enforces GCP Free Tier limits and safe usage caps
Copies the authenticated storage.cloud.google.com URL to macOS clipboard

evals.prompt: Check my current Free Tier usage and storage quota for sharing snips.
evals.expected_output: Executes snip.py with the --usage flag to display Cloud Monitoring API metrics and local quota status.
expectations: Reports monthly upload count and 30-day API requests from Cloud Monitoring
